'''Sealdre''' was an [[Aiel]] Dreamwalker who lived after the [[Breaking]] ended.

{{Ancestry/Rand}}

== History ==
Sealdre was married to [[Mandein]]. She lived in the early days of the Aiel’s settlement of the [[Three Fold Land]].

She tells Mandein that he must go in to the [[glass columns]] as the [[Jenn Aiel]] request, or the sept will die.{{ref/book|4|25}}
